MINUTES
  SPECIAL MEETING: GLENDALE CITY COUNCIL
  BRAND STUDIOS, 1601 W. MOUNTAIN ST., GLENDALE, CA 91201
  February 20, 2024
The Special Public Meeting of the Glendale City Council convened in the Brand Studios, in said
City, at 6:06 p.m. on the above date, pursuant to a call for such meeting signed by the City
Clerk of the City Council, and on file with the City Clerk, a copy of which is as follows:

  February 14, 2024
  Date

A SPECIAL PUBLIC MEETING of the City Council is hereby called to meet at 6:00 PM on
Tuesday, February 20, 2024, in the Brand Studios at 1601 W. Mountain St., Glendale, CA 91201
to consider the following item(s) of business, to wit;
1. ITEMS FOR DISCUSSION:
  a. Brand Hiking Trail Upgrades (Public Works)
  b. North Brand Demonstration Project (Public Works)
  c. Indigenous Tree Ordinance and Canopy Increase (Public Works)

2. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

 Written Notice of said meeting was given, which Notice consisted of a copy of
 the foregoing Call, and was served on each Member of the Council not joining in
 the Call, and upon the in said City not less than 24 hours before the time fixed in
 said Call for said meeting, as follows:
  Upon Elen Asatryan  at 5:00 p.m.  February 14, 2024  Glendale, CA
  Upon Paula Devine  at 5:00 p.m.  February 14, 2024  Glendale, CA
  Upon Ardy Kassakhian  at 5:00 p.m.  February 14, 2024  Glendale, CA
  Upon Ara Najarian  at 5:00 p.m.  February 14, 2024  Glendale, CA
  Upon Dan Brotman  at 5:00 p.m.  February 14, 2024  Glendale, CA
  Mayor Brotman called the meeting to order at 6:06 p.m.

  ROLL CALL
  - All Present

  Tuesday, February 20, 2024, Special Public Meeting of the City Council was posted on
